DisplayName.Value: Junction Studio — Town Road Lane Extension

ShortDescription.Value: Beta junction editing and preset workflows using Town Road Lane data.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — requires the supported Town Road Lane selection/data workflow.
WHAT IT DOES Inspects compatible junctions and applies saved marking/preset data to their supported topology.
HOW TO USE Select a supported junction, make edits, then save/apply a preset or reset the selected junction. Presets must match the target junction's supported approach structure.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Selection depends on Town Road Lane. Invalid presets are rejected before mutation; rollback is attempted if applying a valid preset fails. This is not a guarantee across all junction/topology combinations. Full copy/paste, redraw, save/load and teardown testing is still pending.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.1.4-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Validate preset sizes, finite coordinates and references before clearing existing data. Capture rollback state, cap imported libraries and fix area-redo indexing and city-transition UI state.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
